# breadcrumbs

> Agent-operations machinery you copy into a repo you cannot afford to break:
> memory ledgers, retrieval measurement, CI guards, merge-gate workflows, and
> the pattern essays behind them. Everything is plain text, stdlib-only, and
> meant to be owned and edited after copying; there is deliberately no package.
> Machine-readable inventory with per-artifact assumptions and selftest
> commands: kit.json.

Route by the problem you arrived with. Every artifact states its own
assumptions in its header, and every runnable tool ships an offline selftest.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): the problem, the one-afternoon adoption path, the map.
- [templates/CLAUDE_TEMPLATE.md](templates/CLAUDE_TEMPLATE.md): the rules-file
  skeleton everything else hangs off. Copy this, not this repo's own CLAUDE.md.
- [kit.json](kit.json): the full inventory, problem-to-artifact routing, and
  selftest commands, for programmatic adoption.

## Memory that survives the session

- [templates/CONCLUSIONS_TEMPLATE.md](templates/CONCLUSIONS_TEMPLATE.md):
  the append-only, path-keyed conclusions ledger format with supersession.
- [templates/DECISIONS_TEMPLATE.md](templates/DECISIONS_TEMPLATE.md): the
  decisions ledger; [docs/decision-capture.md](docs/decision-capture.md) is why.
- [templates/SESSION_STATE_TEMPLATE.md](templates/SESSION_STATE_TEMPLATE.md):
  the living handoff between sessions.
- [templates/ledger-tools/memory_engine.py](templates/ledger-tools/memory_engine.py):
  runnable three-tier memory; asserted vs verified, oracle-gated.
- [templates/ledger-tools/capture_nudge.py](templates/ledger-tools/capture_nudge.py):
  the hook that makes capture happen the turn a ruling lands.

## Measuring whether memory works (most systems skip this)

- [docs/memory-measurement.md](docs/memory-measurement.md): the four
  instruments and why a memory entry nobody can reach is indistinguishable
  from one never written.
- [templates/ledger-tools/retrieval_exam.py](templates/ledger-tools/retrieval_exam.py):
  reachability, injection probe, use stamps, the forbidden-hit check, and a
  survey mode that runs against any repo with no adoption.
- [templates/ledger-tools/conclusions_audit.py](templates/ledger-tools/conclusions_audit.py):
  staleness verdicts against the live tree.
- [templates/ledger-tools/SEARCH_MISSES.md](templates/ledger-tools/SEARCH_MISSES.md):
  the ledger for the entry that was never written.

## Enforcement (rules as CI, not prose)

- [ci-kit/guards/](ci-kit/guards/): lint guards, each with fixtures proving it
  bites; [ci-kit/run_guards.sh](ci-kit/run_guards.sh) runs the set.
- [ci-kit/workflows/](ci-kit/workflows/): the fail-closed merge gate, automerge
  with an approval label, and the gotchas that cost real debugging time.
- [ci-kit/migrations/](ci-kit/migrations/): forward-only migration runner with
  an applied-state ledger.
- [ci-kit/preflight/preflight.py](ci-kit/preflight/preflight.py): catch the
  branch collision before you push; SKIPPED is never PASSED.

## Rules to paste into your own rules file

- [skills/](skills/): session efficiency, data truth, flag lifecycle,
  regression layering, reuse-first, delivery protocol, and more; each opens
  with the failure it prevents.
- [checklists/](checklists/): continuity sweep, PR discipline, pre-push.

## Running many sessions (fleet patterns)

- [docs/floating-memory.md](docs/floating-memory.md): the fleet memory
  architecture as a pattern essay; its header states what ships here and what
  does not.
- [playbook/](playbook/): the operating model, coordinator seats, scheduled
  agents, the unattended-agent contract.
- [templates/standing-agents/](templates/standing-agents/): the standing-agent
  fleet kit.

## Optional

- [docs/](docs/): the full pattern-essay shelf, one reasoning essay per
  artifact class.
- [templates/commands/](templates/commands/): slash-command workflows (scout,
  retro, checkpoint, promote, model-check) for harnesses that support them.
- [templates/hooks/](templates/hooks/): harness hooks (pre-compact save,
  PII screen, batch cadence).
- [ci-kit/workflows/greenlight_tiers.py](ci-kit/workflows/greenlight_tiers.py):
  diff-tiered merge gate; docs-class merges on green, the rest waits for the label.
